theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_sa_mollify_lipschitz_close
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L F → ∀ (ρ : Eucl P → ℝ) (σ : ℝ), Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → (∀ y : Eucl P, σ ≤ ‖y‖ → ρ y = 0) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → ∀ x : Eucl P, |(∫ y, ρ y * F (x - y)) - F x| ≤ (L : ℝ) * σ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
